texts: Donkey sells everyday goods chosen with care: homeware, pantry staples and small gifts. Browse what we have, see what it costs, and sign up to buy.
Pick what you like. Pay once. It arrives.
Every product shows its photo, name and price up front, so nothing is a surprise.
One payment, in pounds, with no hidden charges added at the end.
Orders are packed by hand and posted with care. Delivery details live on the How it works page.
Look around freely. Sign up when you're ready to buy.
Browse every product and its price without signing in.
Read how delivery and returns work before you decide.
Use Sign up to head into the shop and place your order.
Glazed by hand, holds a large cup
Jar, flour and a folded recipe card
Everyday goods and small prices from Donkey.
